text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
For real!?
How can you be a flower shop with no flowers!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of Tap Dance City's old friends opened a shop.
We wanted to send a bouquet to celebrate, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What the heck is going on?
All the flower shops around here are completely empty—

Thank you very much for making the arrangements.
Well then, I will take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "...Journey. That huge car behind you, and... those flowers inside. Don't tell me..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well... I see.
It appears I have done you a disservice."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, please forgive me.
After all, it requires a tremendous number of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A single bouquet is plenty for me, but
since we're acquaintances, care to share a few?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It pains me that I cannot accommodate your request,
but this has been planned for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We consulted with the store in advance.
Even so, having everything sell out completely
was unexpected for us as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Attendant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Journey-sama, we should head back to the academy soon...
Otherwise, we won't finish arranging the flowers in time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my...! I am terribly sorry.
I actually have an important appointment after this,
so I kindly ask for your understanding—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Nothing we can do about it, then.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's a parley!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Parley.
If I recall, that means 'negotiation.'
However, I believe our discussion has already concluded."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The negotiations with you ended in failure.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Captains settle things between captains.
With the recipient of those flowers you don't want to keep waiting, that is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A gift you went out of your way to pick up in person...
The recipient must be someone quite important to you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: If they're an opponent like that, I need to show proper respect. I'll go meet them in person, bow my head, and—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, rest assured.
With my legs, I'll definitely reach the academy faster than that car.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to let them know:
'You're about to receive
a wonderful present.'

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh dear, this is a problem. If you do that,
it will completely ruin the surprise I prepared."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I shall share some of the flowers with you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Thanks!
Glad you're someone I can talk sense to!

text_block_list.name: Attendant Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?!
Then the flower count won't match the choreography—!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...It cannot be helped.
I will adjust the plan.
More importantly, Tap—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To spot your opponent's weakness in an instant from so little information...
I truly admire your sharp insight. However—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Please, in moderation.
Otherwise, I will... yes, become weak.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Finally got my hands on it!
Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Well, it was just a hunch, though!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Got lucky with that hit this time!
Luck is a skill too, ya know! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if uncertain, it felt dependable. I felt a strangely reassuring sense of security.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, don't make it sound so bad. 'Negotiation' is a captain's job too, ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A stellar result! Got the prize we came for!
Let's hurry on back to the crew!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finding a way out with sheer audacity.
It made me believe this captain could weather any storm that comes her way.
